clue.text: Judges recalled point in court proceedings

indicators.note: the clue word that signals this step

parts.note: a trial is the hearing of a case in court

indicators.note: recalled is taken as called back, so the word for point is read backwards

parts.note: the nub is the central point of a matter

explanation.surface: Judges look back on a point made during a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Judges' looks like a verb but is the plural noun for the panel; 'recalled' turns the point backwards and 'in' puts it inside the court word.
explanation.definitionFit: A panel of judges or adjudicators sitting together forms this body.

clue.text: Celestial energy shown by article of substance

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy
the is the definite article
something of substance is real, not imaginary

explanation.surface: A heavenly power is revealed by a weighty piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe what is heavenly or otherworldly, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Aim SF film — to be set here?

parts.note: an aim is a plan or intention
E.T. is Spielberg's science-fiction film about an extraterrestrial

explanation.surface: A writer plans a science-fiction film and wonders where it should take place.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: a science-fiction film could well be set on another world.
explanation.definitionFit: Science-fiction stories are often located on some distant world, so it is where such a film might be staged.

clue.text: Hidden, doesn't knock loud enough, maybe, to be heard

indicators.note: to be heard means the phrase is said aloud and the spelling changes to match

parts.note: knocking too softly is to under-rap, giving 'under raps'

explanation.surface: Someone stays unnoticed because their knocking at the door is too quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' admits the phrase is an invented way of describing a too-soft knock.
explanation.definitionFit: Something kept secret or out of public view is kept this way, an idiom for concealment.

clue.text: Second pub, perhaps, to get criticism

parts.note: a pub is one kind of bar, hence 'perhaps'
B is the abbreviation for second, as in second class

explanation.surface: Visiting another pub earns someone a telling-off.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutting remark is a barbed comment, so the word is a synonym for a jibe or criticism.

clue.text: Heard a line twist in tighter corner

indicators.note: Heard tells us the following words are spoken and respelt

parts.note: a line is A CUE (an actor's line) and a twist is a TANGLE, giving 'a cue tangle'

explanation.surface: Someone hears a rope kink in a cramped corner.
explanation.walkthrough: Said quickly, 'a cue tangle' runs together into the two-word answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An angle of less than ninety degrees is sharper than a right angle, so its corner is narrower.

clue.text: Male style, say, recalled in a mixed collection

parts.note: elan is flair or style

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so the abbreviation for say runs backwards

parts.note: e.g. means for example, i.e. say

explanation.surface: A man's fashion sense is remembered as a jumble of things.
explanation.definitionFit: The French loan word names a medley or assortment of various things.

clue.text: Film extracts in middle of week showing solar phenomenon?

indicators.note: in tells us the short extracts sit inside the central letters
middle of picks out the central letters of the word week

parts.note: clips are short excerpts from a film

explanation.surface: Footage shown midweek captures an event in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: When the moon blocks the sun's light, the event is a classic example of a sun-related happening.

clue.text: Cunningly fit things around husband's late working

indicators.note: around says the rearranged letters wrap round the abbreviation for husband
cunningly says the letters of fit things are arranged artfully

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for husband in genealogy

explanation.surface: Someone craftily rigs things round their husband's late hours at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cunningly' makes NIGTSHIFT from FIT THINGS, and 'around' puts it round H.
explanation.definitionFit: A period of employment through the hours of darkness is work done late.

clue.text: Finished with recession, US city is in need of development

indicators.note: recession is a moving back, so the word for finished is read backwards

parts.note: when time is up it is finished
NY is New York

explanation.surface: A US city emerging from an economic downturn needs regeneration.
explanation.definitionFit: Something feeble and undersized could do with growing, so it needs building up.

clue.text: Become enraptured? Request to join parade, nothing more

parts.note: 'fall in!' is the order to soldiers to form ranks on parade
love is a score of nothing in tennis

explanation.surface: Someone asks to join a parade and wants nothing else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'more' is a link word here: the wordplay is only the drill order plus the tennis score.
explanation.definitionFit: Being swept off one's feet romantically is being enraptured, an idiom for becoming smitten.

clue.text: Pub brought in music provider, one delivering spirit

indicators.note: brought in says the pub word is placed inside the other pieces

parts.note: a DJ, or disc jockey, plays recorded music
I is the Roman numeral for one
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A pub hires a DJ, and someone delivers drink.
explanation.definitionFit: In Arabian folklore a jinn or genie is a supernatural being, so a type of spirit.

clue.text: Toilet staff adopting hot water escape mechanism

parts.note: loo is British slang for a toilet

indicators.note: adopting says the pole takes the tap letter into itself

parts.note: a staff is a pole or stick
H marks the hot-water tap

explanation.surface: A toilet's pipe fitted with hot water acts as a plumbing device.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hot water' is not trouble here but the H on a tap.
explanation.definitionFit: A gap in a rule lets someone evade an obligation, so it is a means of escape.

clue.text: Security around display area overlooking fine marine artefact

indicators.note: around says the security word wraps round what remains

parts.note: a seal secures a document or container

indicators.note: overlooking means ignoring, so the abbreviation for fine is dropped

parts.note: a shelf is where goods are displayed
F is the pencil-grading abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: Guards surround a gallery display, positioned above a valuable object from the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overlooking' looks like 'placed above' but means 'ignoring', so fine's letter is dropped; 'around' wraps security round what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A mollusc's discarded casing is an object found by the sea, loosely called an artefact.

clue.text: Put down Republican representative abandoning daughter

indicators.note: abandoning says the daughter letter is left out

parts.note: a delegate represents others

explanation.surface: A Republican delegate walks out on their daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: To demote someone to a lower rank or division is to move them down.

clue.text: Connection I start to build with every Australian resort

parts.note: a bond is a link or connection

indicators.note: start to means only the opening letter of build is used

parts.note: each means every one

explanation.surface: Someone starts building connections with everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: It is Sydney's famous surfing beach.
explanation.definitionFit: This celebrated Sydney beach is a seaside holiday destination.

clue.text: US city routine adopted by US astronomer turning up fuel

indicators.note: in a down entry turning up means the letters are read from bottom to top
adopted by says the city and routine are taken inside the astronomer's name

parts.note: Carl Sagan was an American astronomer
LA is Los Angeles
a rut is a dull routine

explanation.surface: A US astronomer takes up a city's routine and starts producing energy.
explanation.walkthrough: SAGAN holding LA and RUT gives SAGLARUTAN; 'turning up' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Methane piped from underground deposits is burnt for heat, so it is a kind of fuel.

clue.text: Escort petrol comes with these days

definitions.meaning: to escort someone is to lead them out
today's petrol is unleaded, so it comes with the lead taken out

explanation.surface: A Ford Escort runs on the petrol sold nowadays.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing someone out of a room is guiding them, while unleaded fuel has had the metal removed.

clue.text: Senior official dismissing one cleaner

indicators.note: dismissing means sending away, so the letter for one goes

parts.note: the chair presides over a meeting
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A senior official sacks one of the cleaning staff.
explanation.walkthrough: A char, or charwoman, is a British term for a cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: A char is an old British word for a woman hired to clean houses.

clue.text: Write an introduction to governing Asian state

parts.note: to pen is to write

indicators.note: introduction to means only the opening letter of governing is used

explanation.surface: Someone drafts a preface to a book on government in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: It is a state of Malaysia.
explanation.definitionFit: This Malaysian island state is a constituent region of an Asian country.

clue.text: It can't be seen through, despite being of transparent material

definitions.text: It can't be seen through, despite being of transparent material

parts.words: It can't be seen through, despite being of transparent material
parts.note: an artificial eye is made of glass, yet its wearer gets no sight from it

explanation.surface: A paradox: a see-through substance that nobody can see through.
explanation.definitionFit: A prosthetic eye was traditionally made of glass, yet gives no vision.

clue.text: Exact changes heard originally on good authority

indicators.note: changes says the letters are swapped around into a new order

explanation.surface: The exact alterations were heard first from a reliable source.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' works on both EXACT and HEARD; 'originally' is padding. The Latin phrase means 'from the chair', as the Pope speaking infallibly.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin phrase describes pronouncements made with full official authority.

clue.text: Nothing from European country involving a cosmetic

indicators.note: involving says the word for nothing wraps round the a

parts.note: nil means nothing, zero
Polish means from Poland

explanation.surface: A Polish woman's nothing-much makeup.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacquer painted on fingernails is a beauty product.

clue.text: Multi-functional staff, though past their best?

parts.note: to man something is to staff it
if can mean though, as in 'pleasant if dull'
old people may be thought past their prime

explanation.surface: A worker who can do everything, even if they are getting on.
explanation.definitionFit: Manifold means many and varied, so having many uses or functions.

clue.text: Guardsman told to attack the Spanish

parts.note: troops told to attack are sent in
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A soldier is ordered to charge the Spaniards.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentry standing watch is one who keeps guard.

clue.text: Stories about cat in French city

indicators.note: about says the stories go round the cat

parts.note: lies are untrue stories
mog is British slang for a cat

explanation.surface: Tales are told about a cat living in France.
explanation.definitionFit: This city in central France is famous for porcelain.

clue.text: Pace entirely controlled by Republicans?

indicators.note: controlled by says the word for entirely is held inside the party initials

parts.note: the GOP, Grand Old Party, is the US Republican Party
all means entirely, wholly

explanation.surface: A political process run wholly by Republicans.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse's fastest pace is this running gait.

clue.text: Small space satisfactory? Negative response to the fore

indicators.note: to the fore puts the negative word in front of the word for satisfactory

parts.note: no is a negative answer
OK means satisfactory

explanation.surface: Someone asks if a small space is acceptable and is refused.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess or corner is a small enclosed area.
